column1: # The evaluation set of `yaxus polish --mark` (`yaxus bench polish`): `kind<TAB>sentence`.
# In a flawed sentence the unnatural part is in [brackets]; a mark that overlaps it finds
# it. `clean` sentences should get no mark. All sentences were written for this set.
